Barb suggested additional edits are in red.

Map:
•  Request more wintry background
•  Remove pallet trail (no number) from school to CCR
•  Remove Tiny Creek Trail (#35) from school to CCR
•  Change green part of 5K (2k) to blue
•  Stumpy’s Winter Trail from intersection with Cat Road to Winner Creek (small section is currently
   green, rest is black)= make all gray dash.
•  Remove unnamed green trail (probably is Northface road).
•  Change text in Resort area to say: “Refer to Alyeska Ski Trail Map for Resort Area”.
•  Remove rando avy symbol above key.
•  Remove red triangles for End of Trail from map and key.
•  Replace red triangles with yellow avy triangle in each location.
•  Leave avy symbol over Bird-to-Gird as is.

•  Upper Winner Creek Trail should be outlined in yellow as it is part of the Iditarod Trail.
•  Add a “Yield to Snowcat” symbol to the Snow Cat Road between the cat bridge and the powder hut.
•   Is the USFS parking lot by CC Mine actually open in the winter? Are the outhouses open? If not, it
   seems like they should be removed.

Key:
•  Replace red avy End of Trail triangle in key with avy symbol and text: “High avalanche danger beyond
    this point”.
•  Solid Green line explanation: Change “Groomed as conditions allowed.” To “Groomed as conditions
    allow.”
•  Solid Blue line explanation: Remove “The trail is not regularly groomed” and replace with “Groomed
   as conditions allow.”

Trail User section:
•  Change All Terrain Vehicles to: “Unauthorized motorized use on trails is prohibited.”
•  Remove 2nd sentence of Designated Trail. Replace with: “Meadows are closed when not frozen to
   protect wetlands.” I would remove all the Designated Trail text (I’m always off trail in the winter!) and
   bold the whole “Meadows are closed” message above.

•  Do not walk or bike on winter trails when snow conditions are very soft or wet. Post-holing and deep
   bike ruts destroy the track. Please wait until the track freezes up.

Avalanche Box:

•  Change the yellow triangles on either side of the WARNING! to the black/yellow diamond avy symbol.
•  There was discussion about adding the words “Chugach Avalanche Center” by the website address
   www.cnfaic.org. I don’t know if there’s space or if we even agreed this was important….
